result: Reviewed human UniProtKB entries, release 2026_03, read through rest.uniprot.org on 2026-10-21. CPT1A (P50416), liver isoform: mitochondrial outer membrane, residues 123 to 773 cytoplasmic; transfers the acyl group of long-chain acyl-CoA onto carnitine, an essential step for mitochondrial uptake of long-chain fatty acids; inhibited by malonyl-CoA; CPT1A deficiency causes severe episodes of hypoketotic hypoglycaemia, usually after fasting or illness, from infancy or early childhood. CPT1B (Q92523), muscle isoform: strong expression in heart and skeletal muscle, none in liver and kidney. SLC25A20 (O43772): electroneutral exchange of acylcarnitines for free carnitine across the mitochondrial inner membrane. CPT2 (P23786): inner membrane, matrix side; reconverts acylcarnitines into acyl-CoA; the myopathic, stress-induced form of CPT2 deficiency causes recurrent myoglobinuria and episodes of muscle pain, exacerbated by prolonged exercise, fasting, cold or viral infection. ACSL1 (P33121): long-chain fatty acid + ATP + CoA = long-chain acyl-CoA + AMP + diphosphate, including hexadecanoate; Mg2+; mitochondrial outer membrane, peroxisome and endoplasmic reticulum membranes. ACADVL (P49748): FAD; first reaction of mitochondrial beta-oxidation, dehydrogenating saturated C12 to C24 acyl-CoAs to trans-2-enoyl-CoA with electron-transfer flavoprotein (ETF) as physiological electron acceptor; inner membrane; each cycle shortens the acyl-CoA by two carbons and yields one acetyl-CoA, one FADH2 and one NADH. HADHA (P40939) and HADHB (P55084): heterotetrameric mitochondrial trifunctional enzyme specific for long-chain substrates; the alpha subunit carries the enoyl-CoA hydratase and (3S)-3-hydroxyacyl-CoA dehydrogenase (NAD+) activities, including on (3S)-hydroxyhexadecanoyl-CoA, the beta subunit the 3-ketoacyl-CoA thiolase. ETFA (P13804): accepts electrons from acyl-CoA dehydrogenases and transfers them to the respiratory chain through ETF-ubiquinone oxidoreductase; ETFDH (Q16134): transfers electrons from ETF to ubiquinone, inner membrane. ACLY (P53396): cytosolic; cleaves citrate into oxaloacetate and acetyl-CoA. ACACA (Q13085): cytosolic; carboxylates acetyl-CoA to malonyl-CoA, the first and rate-limiting step of de novo fatty acid synthesis; biotin; citrate promotes the most active, filamentous form; phosphorylation at Ser-80 by AMPK inactivates it; inhibited by palmitoyl-CoA. ACACB (O00763): mitochondrial; its malonyl-CoA allosterically inhibits CPT1; activated by citrate; phosphorylation at Ser-222 by AMPK inactivates it. FASN (P49327): cytoplasmic homodimer with 7 catalytic activities and an acyl carrier protein domain; acetyl-CoA + n malonyl-CoA + 2n NADPH = long-chain fatty acid + n CO2; NADPH reduces 3-oxoacyl-[ACP] to (3R)-hydroxyacyl-[ACP]. LPL (P06858): hydrolyses the triglycerides of chylomicrons and VLDL; APOC2 is its coactivator; GPIHBP1 (Q8IV16) anchors it on the luminal surface of capillary endothelium. APOC3 (P02656): inhibits LPL. MTTP (P55157): required for assembly and secretion of apoB-containing lipoproteins; its deficiency causes abetalipoproteinaemia, with virtually no circulating apoB-containing lipoproteins.
